senses.definition: A particular drug used in chemotherapy.
A proteasome inhibitor that is used in cancer therapy
senses.example: In contrast, antitumor activity in xenograft tumors is model-dependent, with some solid tumors showing no response to ixazomib.

senses.definition: A town in Oaxaca, Mexico.
A municipality of Oaxaca whose municipal seat is the town of the same name.
A humanized monoclonal antibody for the treatment of autoimmune diseases. It works by binding to interleukin 17 and blocking its action.
senses.example: More recently, other biological drugs, such as ustekinumab, ixekizumab, tofacitinib, secukinumab and briakinumab, have targeted immunological mediators of the disease.

senses.definition: A municipality of Brussels, Brussels Capital Region, Belgium
Of or relating to the Ixerbaceae.

An extinct dialect of the Tacana language.
An indigenous Maya people in El Quiché Department, Guatemala.
A Mayan language spoken in Guatemala.
Of or relating to a Mamean language family including the languages Ixil and Awakatek.
A monoclinic-prismatic mineral containing iron, manganese, niobium, oxygen, tantalum, and tin.
King of Lapiths, who was punished by Zeus for trying to seduce Hera by being bound to a winged fiery wheel that was always spinning.
senses.example: As to fitfulness, I have never learnt the art of binding myself to any of the wheels on which the Ixions of these days are turning round and round.

senses.definition: A Kuiper belt object (KBO), 28978 Ixion (provisional designation 2001 KX₇₆), once thought to be a possible dwarf planet.
Of or relating to Ixion.
A centaur.

No.
Nothing; nix; often in the phrase "ixnay on ...", indicating something that must not be mentioned, often in Pig Latin
senses.example: Ixnay on the "W-A-L-K" while the dogs can hear you.

senses.definition: To reject or cancel something; nix.
senses.example: If I wasn't so bored out of my mind, I would have ixnayed that idea.

Relating to or caused by hard ticks.
A substance that kills ticks.
Any of various ticks of the family Ixodidae.
An antimicrobial peptide present in ticks of the order Ixodida
Any tick of the superfamily Ixodoidae.
Of or relating to the superfamily Ixodoidae.
Any mite in the family Ixodorhynchidae.
A polypeptide, present in ticks of the genus Ixodes, that inhibits tissue factor diseases
A fossil resin, found in bituminous coal, that becomes soft and sticky when heated.
A town in KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa.
A river in KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa.
Any of the flowering plants in the genus Ixora.

A variety of Agave angustifolia var. angustifolia (syn. Agave rigida), furnishing a strong coarse fiber.
The fiber itself; pita, or Tampico fiber.
